title: A site sets its own byline policy
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-e7acbb.

Satire uses pen names; today the rule is to attribute to AI and never invent an author. Make it a site policy with the honest rule as the default.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in #1419. Decision: the byline policy is a site-rule guideline kind 'byline' (mode honest | pen-names, penNames, note); the honest rule is the default; it reaches the copywriter as a core 'byline' context-pack layer. No code enforces authorship beyond that guidance (none existed before).
